carolyn.name: You're a lot like Suicune.
carolyn.line_a: You said you'd walk over and help it find its way home, and you'd take a breath and walk at your normal pace.
lines_b: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring and purifies water wherever it runs.
It runs across the land with real gracefulness, staying steady no matter how far it travels.
Legend says north winds rise whenever Suicune appears, tying it to long-held stories of the wind itself.
carolyn.line_c: Your answers lean most toward Planner. You like a plan, and you finish what you start.

milo.name: You're a lot like Meloetta.
milo.line_a: You said you'd look up how something works and read, and you'd introduce yourself to new people right away.
lines_b: Meloetta carries the genus Melody Pokémon, and its Pokédex entries credit its songs with inspiring many well-known melodies.
Its melodies are sung with a method built to reach and move an entire audience at once, per its Pokédex entries.
Meloetta's melodies can shape the feelings of any Pokémon that hears them, a gentle kind of influence named directly in its Pokédex entries.
milo.line_c: Your answers lean most toward Curious. You like new ideas and want to know how things work.

andrew.name: You're a lot like Rookidee.
andrew.line_a: You said you'd figure an adult nearby would handle it, and you'd introduce yourself to new people right away.
lines_b: Rookidee will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how much bigger or stronger they are.
Rookidee grows stronger from every battle, since even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
Rookidee takes advantage of the smallest opportunity to slip past a much larger opponent's guard.
andrew.line_c: Your answers lean most toward Outgoing. You get energy from people and like being in the mix.

alex.name: You're a lot like Espeon.
alex.line_a: You said you'd look up how something works and read, and you'd walk over and help it find its way home.
lines_b: Espeon reads shifts in the air to predict things such as the weather or a foe's next move.
It is said to be extremely loyal to any trainer it considers worthy, a bond it takes seriously.
Its fur is sensitive enough to pick up on the smallest shifts in the air around it.
alex.line_c: Your answers lean most toward Curious. You like new ideas and want to know how things work.

guest.name: You're a lot like Braixen.
guest.line_a: You said you'd feel a jolt and take a moment to reset, and you'd chat with a few people you meet.
lines_b: Braixen launches straight into battle once the twig in its tail catches fire, an active, engaged style its Pokédex entry describes directly.
Braixen shares the genus Fox Pokémon with its evolutionary line, and Pokédex entries describe it lighting its own signal fire with a flick of its tail.
The flame from Braixen's tail doubles as a signal to its allies, a cooperative use of its own fire named in its Pokédex entry.
guest.line_c: Your answers lean most toward Curious. You like new ideas and want to know how things work.

josh_first.name: You're a lot like Sprigatito.
josh_first.line_a: You said you'd go for a run or play something active, and you'd listen to their idea and blend your plans.
lines_b: Sprigatito's sweet scent grows stronger in the sun and mesmerizes anyone standing nearby.
In Pokémon Horizons it became Liko's first partner and has stayed close by her side since.
As a Grass Cat Pokémon it washes its face often to keep its plant-like fur from drying out.
josh_first.line_c: Your answers lean most toward Outgoing. You get energy from people and like being in the mix.
